name: HY Electronic (Cayman) Limited
summary: Operating across key Asian markets including Mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, HY Electronic (Cayman) Limited is a company focused on the design, development, production, and sale of a diverse range of semiconductor components. Their core offerings include rectifier diodes, bridge rectifiers, solar diodes, and wafers. The company's extensive product catalog features various specialized diodes, such as fast recovery, high-efficiency, and ultra-fast recovery types, along with transient voltage suppressors, Zener diodes, and low VF Schottky barrier diodes. Furthermore, they supply a broad selection of rectifiers, encompassing standard, superfast recovery, Schottky barrier, high voltage glass passivated, bridge, and photovoltaic solar cell protection Schottky rectifiers. Their portfolio also extends to electrical static discharge guards, transistors for TVS applications, automotive-grade rectifiers, and components for power modules. Beyond discrete components, HY Electronic offers advanced technological solutions, high-efficiency Switch-Mode Power Supply (SMPS) systems, and innovations aimed at vehicle energy saving. The firm also provides comprehensive OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), ODM (Original Design Manufacturer), and OBM (Original Brand Manufacturer) services. These components are broadly applied across numerous industries, from personal computers and the telecommunications sector to consumer electronics, industrial automation, automotive systems, aerospace engineering, medical devices, and solar energy modules. Established in 2009, the company maintains its primary headquarters in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.
